entities.summary: Jesse Allen Hahn is an American professional baseball pitcher in the Toronto Blue Jays organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, Oakland Athletics, Kansas City Royals, and Seattle Mariners. The Tampa Bay Rays selected Hahn in the sixth round of the 2010 MLB draft.
